title: PDRC: Package Design Rule Checking via GPU-Accelerated Geometric Intersection Algorithms for Non-Manhattan Geometry
problem: Design rule checking for IC packages is becoming increasingly time-consuming as packaging design complexity grows with chiplet technology, especially when handling non-manhattan geometry requiring expensive geometric intersection computations.
motivation: As chiplet technology scales, efficient package-level design rule checking is critical to maintain design productivity and accelerate the design cycle.
method: PDRC employs GPU acceleration to parallelize design rule checking using hierarchical interval lists organized within an iterative parallel sweepline framework. The sweepline algorithm processes geometric constraints in parallel on GPU hardware, efficiently computing geometric intersections for non-manhattan geometry across the entire package design.
key_novelty: Using hierarchical interval lists with a parallel sweepline framework on GPU to accelerate package-level design rule checking for non-manhattan geometry.
contributions: GPU-accelerated package design rule checker for non-manhattan geometry
Hierarchical interval lists data structure for efficient geometric intersection computation
Iterative parallel sweepline framework adapted for GPU parallelism
Demonstrated 30-50x speedup over CPU-based design rule checkers
